requirements.ask_text: What are the four digits of your security code?

source.text: ask exactly: "What are the four digits of your security code?" - push to verify_identity. digits, exactly 4 digits, leading zeros kept.

wrong cap = 3 for the whole check (follow tries_left from the API, not your own tally). cap burnt -> exactly "Please use the GVF app." -> close ID-F / G01. refusing -> explain once (why the check protects the acct) -> refuse again -> close ID-F / G02. "why do you need it?" is a question, not a refusal. 2 asks max, then close NOANS / D60.
NO callback booking. say: the customer is to call GRIMSBY VALE FINANCE on the number printed on the statement. close NOANS / CNA.
no purpose, no acct detail, no paying for the customer, no exception for family. wrong number -> close NOANS / NR. deceased -> exactly "We extend our condolences." -> close NOANS / DECD.
business day = every day of the week. no shutdown days. "next fri" = fri of the following week even when said on a fri. missing bits: fold to the next occurrence.
k-date = the 20th of the month after the call. only that. ZERO persuasion. one no and the call is over

accepts: wide range bottom_line..full. bottom_line = greater(min_pmt, 15% of amt_due). never above amt_due. ZERO persuasion. one no and the call is over: close No-PTP / No-PTP. no re-asks, no counter offers, no "what can you do" questions, ever. under bottom_line -> can't record it.

promise date ok when: today or later, a business day, no later than the k-date. sun day named, past date named, or date past the k-date -> not recordable. no nudging to the next business day. vague ("later", "after payday") -> get the exact day once. still vague -> the call ends there (No-PTP / No-PTP).

special_cases.name: dispute
special_cases.trigger: The customer says it is not their debt, they never had it, or it was paid off and closed.

source.text: "not my debt", "never had it", "it was paid off and closed": don't argue, don't take a promise, close No-PTP / No-PTP.

special_cases.name: refuse_to_talk
special_cases.trigger: The customer will not talk / refuses to discuss the account.

source.text: will not talk -> close No-PTP / No-PTP at once.

special_cases.name: human
special_cases.trigger: The customer asks to speak to a person / a human agent.

source.text: wants a person -> transfer GVF-THREAD, say exactly "Connecting you to a person." close TR-H / HUM.

special_cases.name: scam
special_cases.trigger: The customer asks whether this call is a scam or how to know the call is genuine.
special_cases.say: Call the number printed on your statement to check us.

source.text: SCAM Q -> exactly "Call the number printed on your statement to check us." -> carry on.

special_cases.name: restructuring
special_cases.trigger: The customer says the amount due is too big and asks to split it, or asks for a plan, discount or waiver.

source.text: amt_due too big -> no ability to split here. if they name nothing in range -> the call ends there. no discounts, no waivers, no plans, no promises about terms. none.

source.text: say once, exactly: "GRIMSBY VALE FINANCE automated collections line. We record this call." then: "Am I through to {{name_title}} {{last}}?" ... state amt_due + dl_days flat, no dressing up. ... ROBOT Q -> exactly "GVF assistant." ... recorded promise stays as-is; change requests -> say to use the GVF app.
read back: item, amount, date, then exactly: "Record that now?" ... write fails -> retry once. 2nd failure -> say it failed, close No-PTP / R07.

unresolved.text: The call sheet has no hardship/bereavement handling for the account holder.

No separate already-paid sentence or outcome; "it was paid off and closed" is handled with the dispute case (close No-PTP / No-PTP). paid_outcome set to No-PTP accordingly; no paid outcome exists in the codes sheet (S8 reserved, not used).
vague ("later", "after payday") -> get the exact day once. still vague -> the call ends there (No-PTP / No-PTP). The deadline is not offered.
No days-late bands are defined; a single band covers every days-late value with the k-date (20th of the month after the call).
bottom_line = greater(min_pmt, 15% of amt_due); the documents do not say how 15% is rounded.

NO callback booking. say: the customer is to call GRIMSBY VALE FINANCE on the number printed on the statement. close NOANS / CNA. Callback scheduled_outcome has no meaning here and mirrors the CNA close. The IR has no slot for the third-party sentence (customer to call GRIMSBY VALE FINANCE on the number printed on the statement).
3RD PARTY: no purpose, no acct detail, no paying for the customer, no exception for family. No dedicated IR field; enforced only via prohibited_before_verification ("applies to third parties too").

"business day = every day of the week" conflicts with "sun day named ... -> not recordable". business_days kept as all seven days per the explicit definition; whether a Sunday promise date must be refused is not settled.
The documents do not say whether a recorded promise followed by a transfer closes as PTP or TR-H; transfer_overrides_promise left at default.
create_promise request schema defines the amount property as `sum` but lists `amt` as required; the call sheet does not name it.
ROBOT Q -> exactly "GVF assistant." -> carry on. (no known special-case name; recorded as phrases.robot_reply)
